candidates.text: Commerce succeeds to manufacture, and is not a part of it. That which belongs to commerce is within the jurisdiction of the United States
candidates.speaker: Fuller
phrases: Commerce succeeds to manufacture, and is not a part of it

candidates.text: Doubtless the power to control the manufacture of a given thing involves, in a certain sense, the control of its disposition
candidates.speaker: Fuller
phrases: affects it only incidentally and indirectly

candidates.text: Nevertheless it does not follow that an attempt to monopolize, or the actual monopoly of, the manufacture was an attempt
candidates.speaker: Fuller
phrases: the instrumentality of commerce was necessarily invoked

candidates.text: Interstate commerce does not, therefore, consist in transportation simply. It includes the purchase and sale of articles
candidates.speaker: Harlan, dissenting
phrases: Interstate commerce does not, therefore, consist in transportation simply
